sentences.text:
Shaik Hussain Bin Abdul Khader A 1 ... vs The State Of
Telangana on 7 August, 2025

Author: N. Tukaramji
Bench: N. Tukaramji
 The Honourable Sri Justice N. Tukaramji
 Criminal Petition No.10068 of 2025
Order:

This petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking quashment of the proceedings in C.C.No.6195 of 2022 pending on the file of the learned VIII Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nampally, Hyderabad, against the petitioner/accused No.3.
2.

entities.text: VIII Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nampally, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent No.1-State.
3. The petitioner is arrayed as accused No.3 in C.C.No.6195 of 2022 facing accusation under Section 420 of IPC.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that though the petitioner got a strong case even for quashment, as he is determined to see the process through, the insistence for his presence is causing severe difficulty in pursuing his occupation and avocation.
Therefore, prayed for dispensing his personal appearance in the proceedings, unless presence in person is required and such direction would redress his grievance.

5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that there is no specific objection for the prayer,
however pleaded for a direction for appearance of the petitioner on the material stages in the proceedings.

6. Having regard to the submissions, subject to the petitioner appearance through his counsel on every adjournment and physical presence as and when directed by the Court, the in-person presence of the petitioner in the proceedings of the C.C.No.6195 of 2022 pending on the file of the learned VIII Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nampally, Hyderabad, is dispensed with.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nampally, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Additionally it is specified that any lapse in abiding the above conditions would render this order ineffective.
7. With this direction, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
